output.reason: The only upstream evidence is a one-line bugfix title, "Quote nodeSelector values in Helm Chart" [ev-565f3761f656]. It does not say what went wrong before, which values are affected, or how the rendered output changes for an operator who does nothing. The proposed statement says that non-plain-string values (numbers, booleans) are now rendered differently, but the evidence never says that. Since this is a bugfix, the real effect could also be that values which used to fail now work, which would mean no consequence at all. The values snapshots [ev-717ddb6f40cd] [ev-7a67f12867b2] only show that the key exists, and the render validator was inconclusive. To decide between behavior-change and none, we need the PR #7579 description or a rendered-manifest diff between 1.17 and 1.18.
